Wonderful
Sep 2026 • Couples
Wonderful luxury experience.
The location is beautiful, just like in the photos: traditional and elegant.
We ate really well, having an appetizer, a main course (couscous with stuffed squid in my case), a typical dessert, all accompanied by a bottle of wine, and we spent about 50€. 
High price for Tunis but absolutely proportional to the experience.
In addition, I recommend going to visit the hotel and its terrace right next door, it is worth it.
